analysis: Examined all supplied documentation, metadata and inference patch against the indexed threat model and detailed T-041. A retained-frame byte cap alone does not establish bounded decoding work. Lines 1740–1759 document pre-reservation unsupported-control rejection and target-only logprob execution; verify both submission paths and native retirement/accounting. hardware-support.md:453–813 supplies surrounding ownership, calibration, cache and admission invariants, mostly unchanged; the orientation patch also documents GPU wired-limit warnings and revised reclaimable-memory estimates at head:226–234 and 256–262. Review their implementations for admission/availability interactions under TB-007. Existing floor caveats and resident-cache descriptions are not proven PR regressions. No supplied change establishes altered authorization, attestation, hop encryption, token custody or billing. Remaining uncertainty is implementation-level: the referenced changed runtime sources are absent from this batch, so documented guarantees and new media/output-control behavior require cross-file verification.
